biggest_catch: REJECTED: SproutGigs is a real, operating microtask marketplace (formerly Picoworkers) with a live official withdrawal feed showing real PayPal/LTC/USDC payouts, but the company publishes NO concrete payout terms anywhere public — no official minimum-withdrawal figure, no fee schedule, no per-task rate — and third-party reports conflict ($5 vs $5.75 minimum; 1-3 days vs 10 business days processing). Without company-published payout terms, c2 fails.
catches: No official FAQ, terms, or help page stating the minimum withdrawal, withdrawal fees, or processing times could be found on sproutgigs.com.
Third-party sources disagree on the basics: $5 vs $5.75 minimum withdrawal; PayPal/Skrill/Litecoin/Airtm/Uphold availability; processing in 1-3 days vs up to 10 business days.
Third parties report withdrawal fees (e.g. PayPal ~2.9%+$0.30) and an ~18% platform cut, but none of this is published by SproutGigs itself.
New users reportedly must reduce a 'task interval timer' to zero before withdrawing — again, documented only by third parties.

c1.evidence: SproutGigs (formerly Picoworkers) is a live microtask marketplace; its official page sproutgigs.com/workers-making-money-online.php publishes a live 'latest requested withdrawals' feed showing real PayPal, LTC, and USDC payouts to workers.

c2.evidence: FAILED: no concrete payout terms published by SproutGigs itself — no official minimum withdrawal, fee schedule, or per-task pay terms found on sproutgigs.com or in any official document; only third-party reports, which conflict with each other.

c3.evidence: Joining and working is free; no participation fee found — but this cannot be officially confirmed either, since no official worker terms page was found.

c4.evidence: Official sproutgigs.com worker page obtained (live withdrawal feed), but it contains no payout-terms statements.

eligibility: Free account on sproutgigs.com; workers reportedly worldwide. Employer-set tasks (social media, signups, surveys, data entry); pay per task set by the posting employer ($0.02-$1 typical per third-party reports).
notes: SproutGigs is legitimate and paying (the official site's own live withdrawal feed is strong evidence), but it fails the checklist strictly on c2: the company does not publish concrete payout terms. If SproutGigs publishes an official FAQ/terms with withdrawal minimums and fees, this route can be re-verified. Note: do not confuse with Microworkers (R0216), which does publish an official FAQ.

s1.note: No official eligibility or age terms published publicly.

s2.note: No official fee schedule published; third parties report withdrawal fees and platform cuts but these are unverifiable.

s3.note: No official processing-time commitment published; third-party claims range from 1-3 days to 10 business days.

s4.note: N/A — no official payout statements to evaluate.

s5.note: https://sproutgigs.com/workers-making-money-online.php — official domain, but the page states no payout terms.

s6.note: Generic workflow only (sign up, do tasks, submit proof, withdraw) — no concrete official figures to build steps on.

s7.note: Official page retrieved 2026-09-23; it contains no payout terms.

timing: Not published officially; third-party reports conflict (1-3 days vs up to 10 business days).
